title: Five Tiers of Textbook Generation
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: See the five tiers that turn one course description into a whole intelligent textbook, then check which tier does what.

learningObjectives: The learner will identify which of the five tiers of textbook generation matches a description, for 5 descriptions, with at least 4 of 5 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: The book structure tier writes no prose. Explain how a mistake made there could still stop a chapter from being written.
commonMisconceptions: The model writes the course description.
Chapters are written straight from the course description, with no learning graph and no structure step.
MicroSim specifications are written in tier 5, when the MicroSims are built.
The benchmark covers all five tiers.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 4 of 5 correct on the first attempt.
